Definition: The domain-level contract defining what extensions may touch in the domain model and which controls they can never bypass.
Extensions and permissions are denied unless an explicit recorded grant exists.
Extension family mapping external user data into canonical model structures through schema, unit, provenance, privacy, and protected-content checks.
Extension family producing governed payloads through result envelopes, privacy filters, provenance summaries, checksums, and diagnostics.
Extension family producing governed result payloads through result envelopes and checks.
Extension family that may emit structured diagnostics but cannot suppress core diagnostics.
Extension family that may add checks but cannot downgrade solve-blocking, provenance, privacy, rule, or IP-boundary findings.
Extension family that may expose rule-pack metadata or user-owned rule inputs through the sandboxed rule boundary only.
Extension family that may format outputs but cannot embed protected standards content or claim professional approval.
Declaration requesting entrypoint and permissions; grants nothing by itself and must declare required fields.
The only persistence boundary available to persistence-facing extensions, returning governed envelopes.
Governed payload returned to extensions through the persistence and result boundary.
Controls that plugins and adapters must not bypass, covering units, provenance, privacy, rule sandboxing, persistence, diagnostics, and report boundary language.
States distinguishing mechanics solved, user-rule checked, failed, incomplete, and human-review-required.
Screening and quarantine routing for suspected protected standards text, tables, examples, code formulas, or proprietary/private data.
Privacy posture preserving local-first behavior with telemetry off by default and export permission checks.
External, hash-bound record of human review required for professional use; software-generated records are not allowed.
Constraint preventing claims of certification, sealing, approval, authentication, endorsement, or code-compliance for professional reliance.
The contract basis declared by manifests, with checksums using a canonical JSON/JCS-compatible basis.
